messages:
maya: Posted the draft for the product launch blog — includes benchmark graphs, methodology appendix, and proposed webinar CTA. PTAL: https://drive.redwood/example/launch-draft
jonathan: Nice. Quick Q — what should the hero angle be? performance/cost or reliability-first?
lina: +1 on that question. hero image options? I can mock a latency graph + product screenshot. prefer less copy on hero though.
maya: Thinking hero = 'Predictable inference at scale' and a sub-hero about cost. Benchmarks show ~2.5x unit-cost reduction with batching + KV caching in our tests.
harry: For the webinar CTA, suggest: "See a live demo + cost walkthrough". Also we should segment inbound: webinar signups -> webinar list. HubSpot UTM example:
```
?utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic
```
maya: @ellen can legal quick-check the "2.5x" claim and the wording around benchmarks?
ellen: Quick pass: we need a one-line methodology disclosure and a link to the appendix. Suggest: "Based on internal Redwood Inference tests on NVM-GPU 8x; see appendix for test harness and configs." Once that's added, legal OK.
maya: Added that line and appended the appendix link. Also set a canary publish window Wed 9am PST. publish-bot, I kicked off a preview.
publish-bot: deploy-preview created: https://staging.redwood/preview/12345 — snapshot saved.
jordan: FYI sales wants demo leads routed to AE queue tag `Launch2026` in addition to webinar list. Can we do dual routing so AEs get high-intent demo signups?
harry: Yes, we can do dual routing. Plan: webinar_signups -> webinar_list + ae_queue:Launch2026. I'll update HubSpot flow and add AE notif webhook.
lina: Copy tweak: shorten sub-hero to "High-throughput inference with predictable costs" — reads cleaner and fits hero layout.
maya: Good call, updated. Final checklist: copy edits from Lina applied, legal ok (ellen), HubSpot routing updated (harry), staging preview up. @alex can growth sign off on social snippets and timing by EOD?
alex: :thumbsup: I'll draft two social variations — one emphasizing the benchmark stat, one focusing on reliability and demo CTA.
maya: If no objections I'll target Thu 10am PST publish. Assigning final publish to me. If anyone wants to delay, speak up now or before EOD.
jordan: Approved from sales side.
ellen: Approved from legal.
harry: Approved for routing and growth ops.
maya: Thanks everyone — scheduling publish and social queue. Will post final confirmation in this thread when live.
